title_en: 2026 National University Student AI Start-up Hackathon: Call for Participants
summary: Currently enrolled university students nationwide, including those at EduTech Soft Lab consortium universities, may enter the 2026 AI-based National University Student Start-up Hackathon in teams of up to four. Teams must apply online by 17:00 on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, attend a Zoom orientation on 16 November, and take part in the event on 19–20 November 2026 at the Gymnasium, 3rd floor, Recreation Center, Hallym University. Participation is voluntary.
applies_to: Currently enrolled students (재학생) of universities participating in the EduTech Soft Lab consortium and of universities nationwide, who wish to take part. Teams have at most 4 members; 25 teams (100 participants in total) will take part. Participation is voluntary.
conditions: Only currently enrolled university students may participate.
Each team may have no more than 4 members; the event is limited to 25 teams (100 participants).
Each team must choose exactly one of the five given themes and develop an AI (EduTech)-based solution and prototype for a regional problem.
Presentation materials must be submitted by 09:30 on 20 November 2026.
Each team's presentation must be 10 minutes or less.
Taxes and public charges on prize money are paid by the prize winners themselves.
An award may not be given if there is no suitable recipient for that category.
A certificate of participation will be issued.
Lunch and dinner boxes and a late-night snack are provided on 19 November, and a lunch box on 20 November.
steps: Read this notice; the attached poster image (PNG) was not read, so check the original notice for any details it may contain.
Form a team of up to 4 currently enrolled university students and choose one of the five themes.

Apply online by 17:00 on 11 November 2026 using the application link in the original notice (the link appeared incomplete in the text provided; if it does not work, contact the organiser, whose contact details are in the original notice).
Attend the online orientation on ZOOM on 16 November 2026, 19:00–20:00.
Go to the Gymnasium, 3rd floor, Recreation Center, Hallym University and check in your team between 09:00 and 10:30 on 19 November 2026.
Attend the briefing at 10:30 and work on your solution and prototype from 11:00; on-site advisers are available.
Submit your presentation materials by 09:30 on 20 November 2026.
Give your presentation (10 minutes or less) in your assigned session, then attend the special lecture, award ceremony and group photo.
translation:
Notice: 2026 AI-Based National University Student Start-up Hackathon (「2026 AI 활용 전국 대학생 창업 해커톤 대회」)

A. Event: 2026 AI-Based National University Student Start-up Hackathon

B. Dates: Thursday, 19 November to Friday, 20 November 2026
※ Orientation: Monday, 16 November 2026, 19:00–20:00 (ZOOM)

C. Venue: Gymnasium, 3rd floor, Recreation Center, Hallym University

D. Eligibility: Currently enrolled students of EduTech Soft Lab consortium universities and of universities nationwide / up to 4 members per team (25 teams, 100 participants in total)

E. Theme: Regional problems – Discover start-up ideas using AI (EduTech)

1. Education – Problem area: regional education gaps, learning support, improving access to education. Description: Develop a customised education start-up item that uses AI to address regional education gaps (including Gangwon), learning access and individual learning support.

2. Tourism and Transport – Problem area: public transport access, mobility, support for people with limited mobility. Description: Develop a start-up item that uses AI to address public transport access, travel to tourist sites and support for people with limited mobility in regions including Gangwon.

3. Ageing, Care, Medical Services and Welfare – Problem area: growing elderly population, shortage of care workers, access to medical and welfare services. Description: Develop an AI-based care and daily-living support start-up item suited to regional characteristics, responding to the growing elderly population and care-worker shortage in regions including Gangwon.

4. Local Commercial Districts – Problem area: customer acquisition, sales growth, promotion and marketing, demand forecasting. Description: Develop an AI-based start-up item supporting small business owners in regions including Gangwon with customer acquisition, sales growth, serving foreign customers, promotion and demand forecasting.

5. Disaster, Safety and Environment – Problem area: wildfires, heavy rain and snow, mountain accidents, disaster prevention and response. Description: Develop an AI-based safety and disaster-response start-up item that considers regional characteristics such as wildfires, heavy rain, heavy snow and mountain accidents in regions including Gangwon.

※ Each team selects one of the five themes, defines a specific regional problem, derives an AI (EduTech)-based solution and develops a prototype in order to discover and refine a feasible start-up item.

F. Main schedule

Thursday, 19 November
- 09:00–10:30 (60'): Team check-in
- 10:30–10:50 (10'): Hackathon briefing
- From 11:00 (360'): Team work session. ※ On-site advisory panel (help with difficulties and advice on development direction) ※ Lunch and dinner boxes provided ※ Late-night snack provided

Friday, 20 November
- By 09:30: Submission of presentation materials
- 09:30–10:00 (30'): Break
- 10:00–12:00 (120'): Presentations [Part 1] ※ Up to 10 minutes per team ※ 12 teams
- 12:00–13:00 (60'): Lunch ※ Lunch box provided
- 13:00–15:10 (130'): Presentations [Part 2] ※ Up to 10 minutes per team ※ 13 teams
- 15:10–16:10 (60'): Special lecture ※ Tallying of judges' scores ※ Satisfaction survey
- 16:10–16:40 (30'): Awards and group photo

G. Application deadline: Online application by 17:00 on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 (application link given in the original notice; the link appeared incomplete in the text provided)

H. Other: A certificate of participation will be issued.

I. Awards (prize money per team)
- Grand Prize (President of KERIS Award): KRW 5,000,000 – 1 team
- First Prize (President of Hallym University Award): KRW 3,000,000 – 1 team
- Excellence Prize (Director of the EduTech Soft Lab Project Group Award): KRW 2,000,000 – 2 teams
- Special Prize (Head of the Hallym University Start-up Support Headquarters Award): KRW 1,000,000 – 3 teams
※ Taxes and public charges are borne by the prize winners.
※ An award may not be given if there is no suitable recipient for that category.

Enquiries: Hallym University EduTech Soft Lab Project Group (contact details are in the original notice).
